record.question: Out of the given alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words or sentence: A cluster of houses in a village.
record.explanation: Answer B: hamlet. A hamlet is a small settlement or group of houses; it is the closest listed term. “Mohalla” is a neighborhood/locality, but not the best match for a small settlement. Independent check: A hamlet is a very small settlement, fitting a cluster of houses in a village. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hamlet.
